title: Audit repro scripts and docs in the 2026-10-28 audit package are portable and clean up after themselves
acceptance: repro/d1-tooling-deploy-badsha.sh resolves its worktree argument to an absolute path before changing directory, so a relative path works.
repro/d1-tooling-deploy-selfcheck-mutation.sh removes scripts/deploy.sh.mut and its temp dir on any exit (trap), so an interrupted run leaves the worktree clean.
repro/lead-cm02-unbound-eme-chromium.cjs uses an ephemeral port and closes the browser and server in a finally block.

The audit package's lane briefs, lane files, verification.md and e2e-env-patch.diff use repo-relative or placeholder paths instead of /home/user, /tmp/claude-0 and /opt/pw-browsers container paths, per AGENTS.md's portability rule.
nextAction: One docs PR editing files under docs/audits/claude-code-audit-2026-10-28-4c344e2/ only; rerun each changed repro once in a disposable worktree.

evidence.summary: Final review of #644 on a32bdd7: four non-significant findings in archived repro scripts and docs (relative-path cp, no cleanup trap, fixed port, hardcoded container paths). Logged 2026-10-28 under the significance rule.
